audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Volibear all seven stages (content) or six of seven (full) in a matchup he wins 47.58% of. The packet flags it directly. The mirror audit also pins Level 3 as Skill and Levels 4-5 as Nasus.
audit.why: A chart that hands every stage to the losing side is the first thing a player checks and the first thing that costs trust; and it contradicts the mirror at two stages, which mirror-fix.js would overwrite anyway.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side and win[0..6] both set to Skill, Volibear, Skill, Nasus, Volibear, Nasus, Nasus with ratings 5, 6, 5, 4, 6, 4, 3. Levels 2 and 6 stay yours (Thundering Smash online, Stormbringer's tower disable); the rest tracks his stacking.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed Stormbringer grants 'range, tenacity, and sustain'. Riot's text grants a leap, a slow, bonus Health and a tower disable — no tenacity anywhere.
audit.why: A player told he gets tenacity from his ult will walk into Wither expecting the slow to be shortened. It is not.
audit.corrected: Stormbringer: 550-range leap, slow, bonus Health, and it disables the enemy tower where he lands — 160/135/110s. That tower disable is what makes the level-6 dive the real spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Frenzied Maul 'shreds' and described Sky Splitter as flat 'burst'. Neither matches the kit: W applies on-hit effects and marks the target, and the SECOND cast on the same mark is what heals; E only shields if Volibear is standing inside his own blast.
audit.why: The mirror found the same class of error from the other side (stun attributed to the wrong slot, Q described as a dash). Getting the shield condition wrong changes whether the all-in maths works: step out of your own bolt and you get no shield at all.
audit.corrected: Frenzied Maul (5s) marks, applies on-hit, and heals on the re-cast into the mark. Sky Splitter (16s, 1200 range) slows and shields only inside the blast — and Wither's 700-range slow is exactly what drags you off it. Wither is 15/14/13/12/11s; Siphoning Strike is 7.5s falling to 3.5s and resets his attack.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Every reference to Wither said 'when it is down' without a number.
audit.why: The whole lane is timed off one 11-15s ability; without the number the advice is unfalsifiable.
audit.corrected: Wither's 12s window at rank 4 is now stated in dosFull[2].d, phases[3].why and spikes[0].text as the trade window.

edits.before: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Even exchanges favour you because the passive lightning ramps as the trade extends.
edits.after: W start for the bite-trade, or Q into aggressive lanes. Level 1 is even — Siphoning Strike costs him 20 mana and resets his attack.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Nasus under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter shields you only if you stand in your own blast, and Wither's 700-range slow drags you off it — trade, don't commit.

edits.before: At level 3 your full basic kit with W shred and E burst hard-outtrades a farming Nasus.
edits.after: Level 3 is even — your full kit trades hard, but Wither kites it from 700 range.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Nasus down every time Wither is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: Wither is back every 12s at rank 4 and Soul Eater's lifesteal refills him off the wave — take short trades and deny stacks instead.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you keep dominating trades while Nasus can only stack and take chip.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 tilt to him — Wither is back every 12s and his lifesteal holds.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Nasus to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit, but his stacks compound every wave — force the fight now or the window closes for good.

edits.before: At first item you still outdamage him outright and should be punishing every stack attempt.
edits.after: At first item his stacked Siphoning Strike starts out-hitting the W heal-bite you lean on.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Nasus can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items his stacked Siphoning Strike one-shots and Wither guts the attack speed your passive builds — never duel him in the sidelane.

edits.before: With all three basics you win every trade: Q Thundering Smash to close, W Frenzied Maul to shred, E Sky Splitter for the extra burst. Nasus has only Q Siphoning Strike and E Spirit Fire and cannot fight back, so bully him off the wave and deny stacks.
edits.after: With all three basics you can trade: Q Thundering Smash to close, Frenzied Maul's second bite to heal, Sky Splitter to slow. But Wither answers every 12-15s and Soul Eater refills him on the wave, so trade short, deny stacks, and never chase him through the slow.

edits.before: R Stormbringer gives you the range, tenacity, and sustain to dive Nasus under tower or all-in when he tries to farm. His ult Fury of the Sands is defensive, not a duel-winner early, so you keep the initiative through the mid game.
edits.after: Stormbringer is your window: a 550-range leap that slows, grants bonus Health, and disables his tower where you land — the cleanest dive in the lane. Fury of the Sands is defensive, so take the fight before his stacks make it a duel he wins.

edits.before: A Sheen/bruiser first item keeps you ahead in raw trading, but every CS you let Nasus stack narrows the gap. Punish hard now while your kit outdamages his.
edits.after: A Sundered Sky first item keeps your all-in live, but every CS he stacks narrows it — Siphoning Strike is on 3.5s at max rank. Force the fight now.

edits.before: From level 3 through your first item you are firmly ahead — your three-ability rotation with W's shred and E's burst outdamages a Nasus who only wants to farm. Zone him off CS relentlessly and use R to dive or deny stacks under tower; every stack you prevent delays his power curve.
edits.after: Level 3 to your first item is a fight for stacks, not a free lead — Wither answers your rotation every 12s, so trade short around it instead of committing through it. Level 6 is the real window: Stormbringer disables his tower, so dive with your jungler and deny the stacks that decide the game.

edits.before: Trade with W Frenzied Maul active to maximize your shred
edits.after: Re-cast Frenzied Maul into the mark for the heal-bite

edits.before: Nasus wastes Wither — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Wither is down 12s at rank 4 — commit the pattern then.

notes: The mirror (nasus__volibear) reported that it could NOT submit its own phases[2]/phases[3] side flips because the agent believed the ±10% length band applied to enum fields. It does not — ENUM_FIELD in apply-proposals.js exempts phases[N].side, win[N] and ratings. Those two rows may still be wrong on the Nasus page and should be re-run or hand-applied; I have written this side to the values that mirror asked for. Only Level 1 (Skill) came from the packet chart; Levels 2 and 6 are Volibear on real kit grounds (Thundering Smash online, Stormbringer tower disable).
